design_rationale.catalog: Use the complete deterministic memory-1 reactive catalog over local last joint action so that the named classic strategies are not cherry-picked and all response rules of this declared type are included.
design_rationale.horizon_L: L=6 leaves enough room for histories with the same current empirical stage signature but different transition evidence, while keeping exhaustive exact enumeration small enough to audit directly.
design_rationale.continuations: Play-on continuations with tau in {1,2,3} are the gt1 non-intervention catalog. They expose short future predictive laws without importing intervention loops reserved for later steps.
design_rationale.prior: The prior is uniform over ordered automaton pairs from the shared catalog. It is exact and symmetric across players.
design_rationale.payoff_lenses: Pi_2 includes cumulative payoff pair for economic readability. At a fixed game and interface t, this payoff pair is a deterministic function of Pi_1's joint-action counts and the declared payoff table, so Pi_2 is recorded as redundant rather than claimed as a strict lens refinement.

automaton_catalog.generation_rule: All 2 * 2^4 deterministic memory-1 reactive strategies. A strategy has one initial action in {C,D} and one response action for each local profile (own_last_action, opponent_last_action) in {CC,CD,DC,DD}.

history_interfaces.history_definition: A history at interface t is a generated joint-action prefix of length t from at least one ordered automaton pair under the declared initial condition.

micro_state.note: For memory-1 reactive rules, the automaton internal state needed for play-on is the last joint profile, while the full prefix is retained as the history object used for conditioning the prior.

stage_lens_hierarchy.Pi_1: Pi_0 plus exact running empirical distribution of joint action profiles over the prefix, represented by counts with denominator t.
stage_lens_hierarchy.Pi_2: Pi_1 plus cumulative payoff pair under the declared stage-game payoff table.

predictive_signature.conditioning: Uniform prior restricted to ordered automaton pairs whose generated prefix equals the history.
predictive_signature.observable: For lens Pi_k and play-on tau, the future observable is the sequence of Pi_k readouts at interfaces t+1 through t+tau.
predictive_signature.equivalence: Two histories are predictively equivalent exactly when these exact conditional distributions match for every declared play-on continuation.

null_control.restriction: Automaton catalog restricted to the constant strategies AllC and AllD.
